verdict.rationale: Stagehand ships an agent, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows the opposite role: Stagehand exposed as an MCP server to Claude Code and other agents (stagehand-docs-11, stagehand-comm-9). WebMCP invokes tools that websites expose, which is an adjacent feature; neither one documents plugging external MCP servers into Stagehand's agent.
